verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any native versioning, review workflow, or rollback for RudderStack pipelines or transformations. The closest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself. Profiles config lives in 'version-controlled YAML', which relies on the user's own source control. Transformations can be tested against sample events before deploying, which is a pre-deploy test, not version history or rollback. Audit logs record activity but do not provide reversion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
